mapper.update: UPDATE hyperlink_task_account_usage SET reserved_success_slot_count=reserved_success_slot_count+1, in_flight_count=in_flight_count+1, first_used_at=COALESCE(first_used_at,#{now}), last_used_at=#{now}, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND usage_status=1 AND in_flight_count<#{maxInFlight} AND (success_limit=0 OR successful_send_count+reserved_success_slot_count<success_limit)

UPDATE hyperlink_task_account_usage SET reserved_success_slot_count=GREATEST(0,reserved_success_slot_count-1), in_flight_count=GREATEST(0,in_flight_count-1), successful_send_count=successful_send_count+CASE WHEN #{successful} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, usage_status=CASE WHEN success_limit>0 AND successful_send_count+CASE WHEN #{successful} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END>=success_limit THEN 2 ELSE usage_status END, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE hyperlink_task_account_usage SET usage_status=#{usageStatus}, invalid_code=COALESCE(invalid_code,#{reasonCode}), invalid_reason=COALESCE(invalid_reason,#{reason}), version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND usage_status IN (1,2) AND invalid_at IS NULL

UPDATE hyperlink_task_account_usage usage_row SET usage_row.usage_status=#{usageStatus}, usage_row.invalid_code=COALESCE(usage_row.invalid_code,#{invalidCode}), usage_row.invalid_reason=COALESCE(usage_row.invalid_reason,#{invalidReason}), usage_row.invalid_at=COALESCE(usage_row.invalid_at,#{now}), usage_row.version=usage_row.version+1, usage_row.updated_at=#{now} WHERE usage_row.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND usage_row.account_id=#{accountId} AND usage_row.usage_status IN (1,2) AND usage_row.invalid_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hyperlink_task_runtime runtime_row WHERE runtime_row.tenant_id=usage_row.tenant_id AND runtime_row.hyperlink_task_id=usage_row.hyperlink_task_id AND runtime_row.run_status IN (1,3) )
